about.title: About
about.twitchPrivacy: - Twitch: the OAuth token is stored locally in your browser (localStorage) so the app can access rewards and your profile without asking you to log in again on each launch. This is suitable for personal use; any app or script running unvetted code could in theory read this token.
about.elevenPrivacy: - ElevenLabs: your API key is stored locally in the app config and used only to call the ElevenLabs API from your machine. Never share it; anyone with access to this machine could use it.
about.noDataSent: No data is sent to any third-party server other than Twitch and ElevenLabs official APIs. For production or third-party streamers, consider writing a detailed privacy policy for your context.
about.footerTagline: Free TTS tool for Twitch · © 2026 Hiarte
